description: This PHP class handles writing auto-filter information of spreadsheets to an ODS file, specifically generating XML elements related to auto-filters (database ranges and filter buttons) within the OpenDocument Spreadsheet format.

classes.name: AutoFilters
classes.description: Handles writing auto-filter database range XML elements for each worksheet in the spreadsheet when exporting to ODS format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the XML writer and spreadsheet objects.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates XML elements for all worksheets with auto-filters, wrapping them in a database-ranges element if any are written.

methods.name: formatRange
methods.description: Formats the range string for the auto-filter, combining sheet title and filter range.
